key_insight: A structured neural network models anisotropic, nonlinear anhysteretic magnetism through a smooth, convex co-energy density with controlled behavior at infinity.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports physically consistent and numerically robust magnetic-field simulations of electrical steel cores in transformers and generators.
method: Represent magnetic co-energy using a structured neural network.
Enforce convexity, smoothness, and prescribed asymptotic behavior.
Use the resulting constitutive law in finite-element magnetic-field simulations.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests demonstrate strongly anisotropic material responses and robust convergence in finite-element simulations; the abstract gives no quantitative accuracy metrics.
watch_item: The formulation targets anhysteretic response, so hysteresis modeling is outside the stated scope.
paper_title: Structured Neural Network Models for Anisotropic Magnetic Constitutive Laws
